nodes.description: Public owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender at deployment and controls onlyOwner privileges.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer flow.
Token ticker symbol set to ABK in the AiBank constructor.
Token display name set to AI BANK TOKEN in the AiBank constructor.
Token decimals (18) used to compute the initial supply exponent.
Total token supply, 7500000000 * 10**decimals, assigned entirely to owner.
Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner -> spender -> amount, mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
Owned() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner and resets newOwner to zero.
AiBank() constructor that sets token metadata, mints the entire fixed supply and emits Transfer.
constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath sub/add.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' while decrementing the caller allowance.
constant function returning the remaining allowance for a spender.
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract in a single transaction.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts so the token contract never accepts ETH.
onlyOwner function that forwards an arbitrary ERC20 transfer call to a caller-supplied token contract.
Library add with overflow require(c >= a).
Library sub with underflow require(b <= a).
Library mul with overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Library div with require(b > 0).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance lookups and allowance bookkeeping.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an untrusted contract supplied by the caller.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied contract address.
require(msg.sender == owner) authorization gate used by the onlyOwner modifier.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) authorization gate inside acceptOwnership.

edges.reason: Owner is initialized from the caller-controlled msg.sender in the Owned constructor, permanently granting privileged control.
The onlyOwner modifier compares the untrusted caller address against the stored owner.
acceptOwnership authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with newOwner.
transfer debits and credits balances indexed by the caller address.
approve writes the allowance entry keyed by the caller address.
transferFrom debits the caller allowance via allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall stores the allowance under the caller address and forwards it to the callback.
transferOwnership is gated by the stored owner value through the onlyOwner modifier.
acceptOwnership emits the previous owner value in OwnershipTransferred and overwrites it.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the authorization require and promotes it to owner.
The AiBank constructor assigns the fixed total supply.
totalSupply performs unchecked _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] subtraction.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
The constructor credits the entire supply to balances[owner].
transfer mutates balances through SafeMath sub/add operations.
transferFrom mutates balances through SafeMath sub/add operations.
balanceOf returns the stored balance for the queried account.
approve overwrites the nested allowance mapping entry.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] with SafeMath sub.
allowance reads the nested allowance mapping.
approveAndCall sets the allowance before invoking the callback.
The constructor assigns the token symbol.
The constructor assigns the token name.
The constructor computes 10**uint(decimals) for the supply exponent.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner and forwards tokens to the stored owner address.
transferAnyERC20Token performs the external token transfer operation.
The caller-supplied ERC20 contract can execute arbitrary code before the external call returns.
approveAndCall performs the receiveApproval external call operation.
A malicious spender contract can re-enter transferFrom during the receiveApproval callback to consume the freshly granted allowance.
The onlyOwner guard restricts execution of transferOwnership.
The onlyOwner guard restricts execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
The newOwner equality require restricts execution of acceptOwnership.
The _newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner.
The 'to' parameter receives the transferred balance.
The tokens parameter is the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
The spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
The from parameter is debited by transferFrom.
The to parameter is credited by transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balance lookup.
The tokenOwner parameter keys the allowance lookup.
The spender parameter keys the allowance lookup.
The spender parameter is granted the allowance and becomes the callback target.
The tokens parameter is the allowance written by approveAndCall.
The data parameter is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
The caller-supplied spender address becomes the callee of the external callback.
The tokens amount is passed into the untrusted callback payload.
The raw data bytes are forwarded as calldata to the untrusted callback.
The tokenAddress parameter selects the external contract to call.
The tokens parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
The caller-supplied token address is the target of the unsafe external call.

Amount argument consumed by the SafeMath sub/add flow in transfer.
Spender argument written into the allowed mapping by approve.
Owner lookup key argument of allowance.
Spender lookup key argument of allowance.

Allowance amount argument written before the callback.
Raw bytes argument forwarded verbatim into the untrusted receiveApproval calldata.
